## General Menaion (Orloff, 1899)
- https://ccel.org/ccel/a/anonymous/menaion/cache/menaion.txt (public domain)
- Commons only (Lord, Theotokos, Cross, angels, saints by class); no dated propers, no Typikon rules. Slavonic (Russian) edition, Victorian English, KJV-style numbering.
- Use: cross-check Vespers OT readings of commons (Theotokos, Cross confirmed); last-resort text for common hymns (parish > DCS > ANCA > this).
